podcast.body: This super rare 4-track cassette was recorded in 1986 by the teenage band, before they were known as Radiohead. It was a part-time endeavor, and the songs lacked a defined style, including tracks like "Fat Girl," "Fragyle Friend," and "Everybody Knows." "Anna Friday managed to pull together a 4 track cassette in 1986."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
